items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: Vertically stacked interactive headings that each reveal a content section.

items.name: actions
items.title: Actions
items.description: Icon-button toolbar for a chat message (copy, retry, rate…): ghost icon buttons each REQUIRING an accessible label that doubles as its tooltip — props-fed and purely presentational.

items.name: agent
items.title: Agent
items.description: Agent-configuration display card: name + model chip header, system instructions (inline or folded behind a Radix collapsible), and a tool chip list. Props-fed — models the config structurally with no AI SDK import; model ids and tool names stay mono and LTR.

items.name: alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: Callout for user attention with title and description.

items.name: alert-dialog
items.title: Alert Dialog
items.description: Modal dialog that interrupts the user for a required confirmation.

items.name: android
items.title: Android
items.description: Generic Android-style phone frame for app screenshots — punch-hole camera, gesture pill and side buttons as aria-hidden CSS layers around an arbitrary screen slot on a labeled figure root; width-sized with a fixed 9:19 aspect, dependency-free, static.

items.name: animated-list
items.title: Animated List
items.description: Reveals its children one at a time — each new item springs in at the top while the rest shift down — with a deterministic prerender (first item ships in the initial HTML, the timer starts client-side) and instant swaps under reduced motion.
keywords: new items spring in on top

items.name: animated-shiny-text
items.title: Animated Shiny Text
items.description: Muted text with a foreground shine sweeping across via background-position; static under reduced motion.

items.name: animated-tabs
items.title: Animated Tabs
items.description: Tabs whose active-state pill slides between triggers via a shared layoutId (per-instance useId, so two mounted instances never share one pill); the Radix primitive keeps tablist/tab/tabpanel roles, arrow keys, and aria-selected.

items.name: announcement
items.title: Announcement
items.description: Pill-shaped announcement for product updates — optional themed tag chip, link mode with an external-tab annotation and an RTL-mirrored arrow, plain-span fallback for non-link use; token-only styling with lucide as its whole footprint.

items.name: area-chart
items.title: Area Chart
items.description: Prop-driven area chart over recharts — overlaid, stacked, or normalized to 100% (stacked="expand" with automatic percent ticks). Gradient fills, monotone/linear/step curves, reference lines, axis tick formatters, legend position, and per-series legend icons; colours from var(--chart-1..5) so every palette restyles it. Entrance animation off, accessibilityLayer on, and an sr-only ChartDataTable alongside.

items.name: artifact
items.title: Artifact
items.description: Shell for AI-generated content (documents, code, drafts): a header row with icon, title, and an actions slot over a bordered content well — purely structural and props-fed; pair it with the actions toolbar and your own renderer.

items.name: aspect-ratio
items.title: Aspect Ratio
items.description: Constrains content to a fixed width/height ratio.

items.name: attachment
items.title: Attachment
items.description: File and image chips for chat composers and messages — icon or image media, upload states (idle, uploading, processing, error, done) with a shimmering title that stills under reduced motion, separately clickable actions above a full-card trigger, and a snap-scrolling AttachmentGroup rail.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: Image element with graceful fallback for user identity.

items.name: avatar-circles
items.title: Avatar Circles
items.description: Overlapping avatar stack with an optional linked "+N" count cell; entries without an image render a token-colored initials disc (derived from alt when initials are omitted), every cell carries an accessible name, and the overlap is RTL-safe. Static — nothing animates.

items.name: avatar-group
items.title: Avatar Group
items.description: Overlapping stack of composed Avatar primitives — semantic ul/li rows whose tooltip triggers open on hover AND keyboard focus, a motion-reduce-aware hover raise, RTL-safe margin-inline overlap, and an automatic "+N" overflow disc; the flat data-driven sibling is avatar-circles.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: Small status descriptor for UI elements.

items.name: banner
items.title: Banner
items.description: Dismissible announcement bar — icon, message and action slots with a controllable visible pair over use-controllable-state, the live role="status" region scoped to the message node only, a labeled dismiss button, inset and tone variants; no animation to suppress.

items.name: bar-chart
items.title: Bar Chart
items.description: Prop-driven bar chart — grouped, stacked, or 100%-normalized (stacked="expand"); vertical or horizontal bars. Value labels outside or inside the bars, per-bar categorical colours, reference lines (a zero line for negative values), axis tick formatters, legend position; colours from var(--chart-1..5). Entrance animation off, accessibilityLayer on, and an sr-only ChartDataTable alongside.

items.name: bento-grid
items.title: Bento Grid
items.description: Feature grid of BentoCard cells — decorative background slot, icon + name + description, and a CTA that large screens reveal on hover or keyboard focus (focus-within) while the content lifts; transitions are disabled under reduced motion so the same states apply instantly.

items.name: blog-01
items.title: Blog 01
items.description: Card-grid blog section — cover wash, semantic <time>, and balanced titles per article, with a View All CTA. Articles arrive via props; covers are decorative chart-token gradients, so every palette restyles them.

items.name: blog-02
items.title: Blog 02
items.description: Flat-list blog section — hover-accent rows with an sr-only "Published on" description list per article, heading + intro copy, and a View All CTA. Articles via props; decorative chart-token cover washes.

items.name: blur-text
items.title: Blur Text
items.description: Word-by-word blur-to-focus reveal once in view — the dead-simple dedicated sibling of split-text: same SEO-safe arm-gate, accessible-name-over-aria-hidden-words contract, and static reduced-motion fallback.

items.name: border-beam
items.title: Border Beam
items.description: A beam of light traveling around the parent's border on an offset-path with a chart-token gradient, parked static under reduced motion.

items.name: bounce-text
items.title: Bounce Text
items.description: Letters bounce up off an invisible ground line with damped rebounds in sequence once in view — glyphs rest at the baseline so the prerender IS the final state (no hidden text); raw string as accessible name over aria-hidden glyphs, never leaves the baseline under reduced motion.

items.name: branch
items.title: Branch
items.description: Version navigation for regenerated chat messages: renders only the current version while previous/next buttons page a plain-text "2 of 3" counter — end buttons stay focusable via aria-disabled + guard, chevrons flip under RTL, the index clamps when versions disappear; controlled or uncontrolled.

items.name: breadcrumb
items.title: Breadcrumb
items.description: Path-style navigation showing the route to the current page.

items.name: bubble
items.title: Bubble
items.description: The framed conversational surface — seven token-derived variants (default, secondary, muted, tinted, outline, ghost, destructive), button/link content via asChild with visible focus rings, and reaction pills absolutely positioned at logical start/end offsets.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Themed button with variants and sizes; supports asChild composition.

items.name: button-group
items.title: Button Group
items.description: Groups related buttons into a single segmented control.

items.name: calendar
items.title: Calendar
items.description: Date grid for picking days, ranges, and months (react-day-picker).

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: Container with header, content, and footer sections.

items.name: carousel
items.title: Carousel
items.description: Embla-powered carousel with previous/next controls and RTL support.

items.name: chain-of-thought
items.title: Chain of Thought
items.description: Collapsible ordered reasoning steps for transparent AI workflows: per-step status icons (complete / active-with-spinner / pending, each with an sr-only status suffix) on a start-side rail with room for result chips — props-fed, aria-expanded from Radix, spinner honoring reduced motion.

items.name: chart
items.title: Chart
items.description: Recharts wrapper wired to the chart-1..5 theme tokens — every chart re-colors with the active palette.

items.name: chart-data-table
items.title: Chart Data Table
items.description: A chart's text alternative — the same rows as a real table, visually hidden by default. WCAG 1.1.1 wants an equivalent text form and recharts cannot supply one: accessibilityLayer makes points keyboard-reachable but does not make a plotted shape readable. Category column first, as each row's header. Plain table markup, so it drops next to a hand-rolled chart with no extra component.

items.name: chart-series
items.title: chart-series
items.description: The series contract behind every chart preset: the ChartSeries descriptor (label, colour, legend icon), the ChartReferenceLine descriptor, the var(--chart-1..5) ramp, and the helpers that derive a ChartContainer config plus the data-table columns from it. Runtime-import-free.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: Control that toggles between checked and unchecked.

items.name: checkpoint
items.title: Checkpoint
items.description: Conversation save-point marker: a bookmark chip centered on a separator line with an optional Restore action — deliberately tiny, it marks a moment and nothing more.

items.name: choicebox
items.title: Choicebox
items.description: Card-style single-select radio group with title, description and icon slots over native sr-only inputs — arrow-key roving, checked-card token styling with a non-color dot indicator, dependency-free, on the shared RHF-agnostic forms contract.

items.name: circular-text
items.title: Circular Text
items.description: Text arranged on a circle with each glyph rotated to its tangent, the ring spinning slowly on the stock spin keyframes (direction-agnostic inset-0 glyph wrappers, optional reverse); the raw string is the accessible name over the aria-hidden ring, static under reduced motion.

items.name: clock-text
items.title: Clock Text
items.description: Live clock as one plain text node: ticks scheduled on exact second (or minute) boundaries, each update a string swap — no per-digit spans, no live region, nothing moves. Deterministic prerender via the now anchor (pass now + timeZone for prerendered output); en-US digits, IANA time zones, 12/24-hour. Semantic time element, LTR-pinned.

items.name: code-block
items.title: Code Block
items.description: Code block with a filename header, CSS-counter line numbers excluded from selection and the copy payload, a working copy button (use-copy-to-clipboard + one polite announcement), and a focusable labeled horizontal scroll region over semantic pre/code; highlighting composes later via pre-tokenized children.

items.name: collapsible
items.title: Collapsible
items.description: Region that expands and collapses from a trigger.

items.name: color-picker
items.title: Color Picker
items.description: Swatch presets plus free text for any CSS color, with a hex-gated native picker and non-color selection markers (check icon + sr-only, never color alone).

items.name: colorful-text
items.title: Colorful Text
items.description: Per-character color cycling: every glyph rides one hue-rotate keyframe loop with a negative phase offset, shimmering the string through the hue wheel from a theme-token anchor; raw string as accessible name over aria-hidden glyphs, static base color under reduced motion.

items.name: combobox
items.title: Combobox
items.description: Single-select autocomplete over the Popover + Command pattern — type to filter, arrows and Enter to pick, selection closes the popover, and the chosen option is checked with sr-only text (never icon-only).

items.name: command
items.title: Command
items.description: Composable command palette / fuzzy menu (cmdk).

items.name: commit
items.title: Commit
items.description: Git-commit display card: message + seven-character hash chip (full hash for screen readers and on hover), author/date meta over a semantic time element, +/− stats, and a changed-file list with A/M/D/R status letters — visible text with sr-only words, so colour is never the only channel. Hashes and paths pin LTR; no git access, no date library.

items.name: comparison-table
items.title: Comparison Table
items.description: Static feature-by-plan comparison grid. Row headers are th scope="row" so a cell announces "Custom domains, Pro, included"; boolean cells always pair their icon with sr-only text, and a highlighted column is marked in words as well as tint.

items.name: confetti
items.title: Confetti
items.description: canvas-confetti wrapper (Confetti canvas with a fire ref API plus ConfettiButton) that resolves the theme's chart tokens to concrete colors at fire time and skips firing under reduced motion.

items.name: confirmation
items.title: Confirmation
items.description: Approval card for agent tool execution: title and detail with Approve / Deny actions while pending; once resolved the buttons give way to an approved or denied chip (icon plus text, never color alone) — props-fed, the decision stays in the consumer callbacks.

items.name: context-menu
items.title: Context Menu
items.description: Right-click menu with items, checkboxes, and radio groups.

items.name: context-meter
items.title: Context Meter
items.description: Compact context-window meter for AI chat headers: an aria-hidden SVG progress ring beside a real-text percentage (destructive tone past 80%), expanding to a hover-card breakdown of tokens, window size, and cost in fixed en-US formatting; the trigger is a real button so keyboard users get the breakdown too.

items.name: copy-button
items.title: Copy Button
items.description: Icon button that copies its value to the clipboard and briefly swaps Copy for Check with a motion scale, swapping instantly under reduced motion.

items.name: count-up
items.title: Count Up
items.description: Counts from 0 up to its value when scrolled into view (once); the prerendered text and screen-reader label always carry the final Intl-formatted number, and reduced motion skips the count entirely.

items.name: countdown-button
items.title: Countdown Button
items.description: Self-locking "Resend code (30s)" button — the click fires, then an aria-disabled click guard (never native disabled, so focus is kept) with a visible aria-hidden ticking suffix on a setTimeout chain anchored to a handler-captured deadline; one polite region announces only the lock ("Available in Ns") and the release ("Ready"). Static — no animation.

items.name: countdown-text
items.title: Countdown Text
items.description: Live countdown to a target date with per-digit slide transitions, ticks scheduled on exact second boundaries against a deadline captured once, an optional deterministic-prerender anchor, and an onComplete callback; digits are aria-hidden behind one static sr-only label — nothing announces per tick — and reduced motion swaps digits instantly.

items.name: counter
items.title: Counter
items.description: Quantity stepper on the WAI-ARIA spinbutton pattern — one keyboard stop (arrows, PageUp/Down, Home/End) between pointer plus/minus buttons, with a direction-aware odometer slide that collapses to an instant swap under reduced motion; the interactive sibling of the display-only motion-number.

items.name: counter-button
items.title: Counter Button
items.description: Button with a count badge that rolls to the new value on each click — the motion-number odometer reduced to one aria-hidden cell, with the real count in one sr-only polite region so assistive tech hears the total exactly once per click; distinct from the forms counter (a spinbutton input) and motion-number (a readout), instant swap under reduced motion.

items.name: curved-text
items.title: Curved Text
items.description: Text flowing along an SVG curve as a seamless marquee: one copy measured after mount, duplicated to overfill the path, a rAF loop sliding startOffset through exactly one copy-length per wrap — runs only in view, never under reduced motion (static curve); the raw string is the SVG accessible name.

items.name: data-grid-cells
items.title: Data Grid Cells
items.description: A rich-cell renderer kit exported as real API — status badge with toned dot, progress meter, person cell, hand-rolled SVG sparkline, currency with delta arrow, star rating, tag chips with overflow, truncation tooltip, and a kebab row-actions menu — plus a live showcase table whose price column drifts on a deterministic cycle and flashes changed cells. Sparklines and star rows are sealed behind real accessible names; the flash never renders under reduced motion.

items.name: data-grid-chrome
items.title: Data Grid Chrome
items.description: Everything around a data grid, assembled: a toolbar with quick filter, column-visibility menu, and an action slot; sortable headers; the three-part pager (page-size select, a 1–10 of 97 range readout, first/prev/editable-page/next/last); a status bar with total, filtered, and sum/avg tiles; and loading / no-rows overlay states with aria-hidden skeleton rows. One polite region speaks range and state changes, and the page input is a real labelled spinbutton that clamps on commit.

items.name: data-grid-column-manager
items.title: Data Grid Column Manager
items.description: The columns tool panel beside its live table, one table instance driving both: search the column tree, flip a tri-state Select all or whole groups with their own tri-state checkboxes, hide single columns, and drag a grip to reorder within a group — with the full keyboard grab pattern and Escape cancel. Reset restores defaults; grouped defs render a two-row header spanning children with scope="colgroup". One polite region announces show/hide, reorder, and reset.

items.name: data-grid-columns-dnd
items.title: Data Grid Columns DnD
items.description: Interactive column controls over TanStack Table: click-to-sort cycles with Shift multi-sort, a drag grip that reorders unpinned columns with a pointer ghost, a role="slider" resize handle stepped by arrow keys, and pin-to-edge / hide via each column's menu. aria-sort lands on the primary sorted column only, the grip carries the full keyboard grab pattern with Escape restore, and one polite region announces every reorder.

items.name: data-grid-editable
items.title: Data Grid Editable
items.description: Inline cell editing with the full keyboard state machine: begin with double-click, Enter, F2, or by typing (the character pre-fills), commit with Enter or by leaving the cell, Tab commits and opens the next editable cell, Escape cancels. Ships text, number-with-steppers, select, and date editors; a failing validator blocks the commit with an inline aria-described message instead of a second live region, and committed cells keep a tick. Focus returns to the cell after its editor closes.

items.name: data-grid-filters
items.title: Data Grid Filters
items.description: Every table filter surface at once: per-column funnel popovers holding an operator-pair text panel (contains / equals / begins with, AND/OR second condition) or an Excel-style distinct-value checklist with search, counts, and a tri-state Select all; and a global quick filter. One polite region announces the match count and the funnel fills while its column filters.

items.name: data-grid-group-panel
items.title: Data Grid Group Panel
items.description: Row grouping built on the affordance the pattern is known for: drag a header into the panel strip (or press its Group-by button) and it becomes a removable chip — reorderable by pointer drag or keyboard — whose click cycles the sort. Group rows carry a chevron, per-level indent, the value with its child count, and sum/avg/count aggregate tiles; a grand-total footer sums the whole set. Dragging is never the only path — every chip action is a labelled button — and one polite region announces each grouping change.

items.name: data-grid-master-detail
items.title: Data Grid Master Detail
items.description: Expandable master-detail rows: a chevron per row opens a full-width detail row holding arbitrary JSX (line items, summary cards, a form), rows stay independently open, and Expand all / Collapse all sit in the toolbar. Chevrons are real buttons with aria-expanded and aria-controls; the detail is a real <tr> so the table stays valid for assistive tech, and the height reveal collapses to instant under reduced motion.

items.name: data-grid-selection
items.title: Data Grid Selection
items.description: Multi-row selection done properly: a tri-state header checkbox, Shift-click range selection back to the last touched row, selected-row highlighting, and a floating bulk-action bar that slides up with the count, your action buttons, and Clear selection. Every checkbox is individually labelled and one polite region speaks the selection count; the bar appears instantly under reduced motion.

items.name: data-grid-tree
items.title: Data Grid Tree
items.description: A tree grid over data that is already hierarchical (unlike grouping, which derives it): children indent behind rotating carets, the quick filter keeps every ancestor of a matching row so results stay navigable, and a grip reorders each row among its siblings by pointer drag or entirely by keyboard with Escape restore. Carets announce natively via aria-expanded and one polite region speaks reorders and filter results.

items.name: data-table
items.title: Data Table
items.description: Sortable, filterable, paginated table over TanStack Table — columns + data in, every feature a prop (global search, column visibility, row selection). Ships the a11y a bare <table> lacks: a required <caption>, scope="col", aria-sort on the sorted column only, and a polite live region for the match count.

items.name: data-table-column-header
items.title: Data Table Column Header
items.description: Header-cell content for a sortable column: a real button opening an ascending / descending / hide menu, with a direction icon. Exports columnAriaSort() for the aria-sort the <th> must carry — a visual arrow with no programmatic state fails WCAG 4.1.2.

items.name: data-table-pagination
items.title: Data Table Pagination
items.description: Table-footer pager for a TanStack table — first/previous/next/last, a polite live page counter, and a rows-per-page picker. Button-driven for paging a client-side dataset in place; use the pagination item when each page is a real URL.

items.name: date-picker
items.title: Date Picker
items.description: Popover + Calendar date field, single or range mode via the discriminated mode prop — no time input (that is datetime-picker's job). Deterministic today/defaultMonth props keep prerendered demos stable.

items.name: datetime-picker
items.title: Datetime Picker
items.description: Popover composing the Calendar with a matching time input; the trigger shows the date-fns 'PPP p' formatted selection or a placeholder.

items.name: decrypt-text
items.title: Decrypt Text
items.description: Matrix-style decryption: characters cycle through a charset and settle onto the target left-to-right once in view; the prerender ships the real string (never noise), the accessible name stays the target while the aria-hidden display scrambles, and reduced motion shows it instantly.

items.name: depth-button
items.title: Depth Button
items.description: 3D pressed-down button — a primary face raised on a darker color-mix edge that the press collapses, travel set by a depth prop; the focus ring stays on the stable outer shell so it never moves with the face.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: Modal window overlaid on the page.

items.name: diff-text
items.title: Diff Text
items.description: Line-diff display: added lines toned through the palette over a faint wash, removed lines destructive, context muted — with a visible +/− symbol column, so colour is never the only channel and screen readers hear the change kind. Parses a unified-diff string by prefix or takes pre-parsed lines. Static by design; focusable labelled scroll region, LTR-pinned.

items.name: direction
items.title: Direction
items.description: DirectionProvider + useDirection — sets ltr/rtl for every Radix primitive underneath; the RTL entry point for bidirectional apps.

items.name: dock
items.title: Dock
items.description: macOS-style dock — pointer-proximity magnification via motion springs gated to fine pointers without reduced motion (everyone else gets a static evenly-sized dock with identical markup), real buttons/links with tooltips that also open on keyboard focus, self-mounted provider.

items.name: dot-matrix-text
items.title: Dot Matrix Text
items.description: A 5×7 dot-matrix display: one SVG per character from a hand-authored bitmap table (A-Z, 0-9, basic punctuation), 1em tall, currentColor-driven, with an optional unlit-dot ghost grid. One role="img" accessible name over aria-hidden glyphs. Static — no scroll, no glow.

items.name: dot-pattern
items.title: Dot Pattern
items.description: Static SVG dot-grid background that tiles its container via one <pattern> def; dots draw with currentColor so a text token on className recolors them (default text-muted-foreground/80). Prerender-safe, nothing animates.

items.name: download-button
items.title: Download Button
items.description: Button whose surface fills start-to-end while downloading — an aria-hidden width layer anchored to the inline start (RTL-correct), aria-busy with an aria-disabled click guard, real progress or a built-in auto-completing simulation, and one polite region announcing status transitions only, never per-percent; under reduced motion the width updates without gliding.

items.name: drawer
items.title: Drawer
items.description: Touch-friendly bottom/side drawer (vaul).

items.name: drop-cap
items.title: Drop Cap
items.description: Editorial illuminated first letter styled entirely through ::first-letter (logical float-start + scaled font-size) — the markup stays one untouched paragraph, RTL-correct, nothing for screen readers to stumble on. Static typography.

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.title: Dropdown Menu
items.description: Menu of actions opened from a trigger.

items.name: elastic-slider
items.title: Elastic Slider
items.description: Radix-backed slider whose track assembly rubber-band stretches when a pointer drags past either end and springs back on release, keeping native slider keyboard and ARIA intact.

items.name: empty
items.title: Empty
items.description: Empty-state block with icon, title, description, and actions.

items.name: env-vars
items.title: Env Vars
items.description: Environment-variable list with per-row visibility toggles: values start masked behind a fixed-width dot run (constant length — the mask never leaks how long a secret is) and reveal via an aria-pressed eye button; an optional copy button announces through one polite region. Names and values pin LTR.

items.name: expanding-card
items.title: Expanding Card
items.description: Disclosure card whose box FLIPs between its collapsed and expanded layouts via motion's layout prop, with a heading-wrapped aria-expanded trigger, a rotating chevron, controlled or uncontrolled state, and zero-duration transitions under reduced motion.

items.name: experience-01
items.title: Experience 01
items.description: Work-experience timeline as semantic markup — nested ordered lists per company and position, period + employment-type lines, Badge skill chips, initials company discs. Everything arrives via the experiences prop.

items.name: field
items.title: Field
items.description: Form field scaffolding — label, control, description, and error wiring.

items.name: file-tree
items.title: File Tree
items.description: File tree with the real ARIA tree keyboard contract, hand-rolled because a disclosure primitive cannot provide it: each row IS the focusable treeitem (no nested buttons), roving tabindex, Arrow keys over visible rows with expand/collapse on the logical inline keys (mirrored under RTL), Home/End, Enter/Space. Selection is controlled-or-uncontrolled via use-controllable-state. Props-fed display — no filesystem access.

items.name: file-upload
items.title: File Upload
items.description: Accessible dropzone with a keyboard-first browse button, constraint-validated file list (accept/size/count via onReject), per-file remove, and polite add/remove announcements.

items.name: flicker-text
items.title: Flicker Text
items.description: Failing-fluorescent flicker: each glyph dips brightness on its own desynchronized cycle via deterministic pseudo-random delays (prerender and hydration agree), shallow and sparse — far below flash thresholds; raw string as accessible name over aria-hidden glyphs, full brightness under reduced motion.

items.name: flickering-grid
items.title: Flickering Grid
items.description: Canvas grid of squares flickering at random opacities, theme-reactive by default (var(--chart-1) resolved at runtime and re-resolved on theme change); the rAF loop pauses offscreen and reduced motion draws one static frame instead.

items.name: flip-button
items.title: Flip Button
items.description: 3D flip between a front and a back face on hover and keyboard focus, on a motion spring — both faces aria-hidden with a constant sr-only accessible name, focus ring on the stable outer button, axis x or y; reduced motion runs the rotation at duration 0, an instant face swap with identical DOM.

items.name: flip-list
items.title: Flip List
items.description: FlipList/FlipListItem pair whose rows FLIP-animate to their new slots on reorder (motion layout + a shared spring); the consumer owns the order state with stable keys, and reduced motion applies the swap instantly.

items.name: floating-label-input
items.title: Floating Label Input
items.description: Input whose visible label floats from the placeholder position to the top edge on focus or value — pure peer/placeholder-shown CSS, no JS state.

items.name: flow-button
items.title: Flow Button
items.description: Pill button ringed by a conic chart-token gradient that rotates half a turn on hover/focus-visible — an oversized aria-hidden conic layer clipped by the button (the gradient-border-card technique) on a pure CSS transform transition, instant under reduced motion; no JS state.

items.name: flow-canvas
items.title: Flow Canvas
items.description: A themed React Flow canvas for node graphs — pipelines, org charts, workflow builders. Maps React Flow's --xy-* custom properties onto the palette tokens so all 40 themes restyle the canvas, its controls and its minimap, with no theme provider to mount. Renders a visually-hidden summary of every node and its outgoing connections as the graph's text alternative.
items.docs:
flow items need React Flow's stylesheet. Add it to your Tailwind entry, after the tailwindcss import:

  @import '@xyflow/react/dist/style.css';

items.name: flow-diagram
items.title: Flow Diagram
items.description: A read-only topology — pipeline, state machine, approval chain, org chart — laid out from a column/lane grid rather than pixels, so the shape is data. Derives everything React Flow normally measures in a browser (box sizes, exact handle coordinates, viewport bounds) up front, which is its documented server-rendering contract: a prerendered page ships the real diagram in its HTML instead of an empty container. Handles are narrowed by the link graph, and nothing drags, connects, or captures the page's scroll.
items.docs:

items.name: flow-edge
items.title: Flow Edge
items.description: A token-styled smooth-step edge with an optional midpoint label rendered as real HTML through EdgeLabelRenderer, so it keeps the type scale and surface tokens and stays legible at any zoom. `data.animated` marches the dashes toward the target and goes solid under prefers-reduced-motion. Ships a module-scope flowEdgeTypes map.
items.docs:
flow items need React Flow's stylesheet. Add it to your Tailwind entry, after the tailwindcss import:

  @import '@xyflow/react/dist/style.css';

items.name: flow-node
items.title: Flow Node
items.description: A token-styled custom node for a flow canvas: label, optional description, a status dot paired with an sr-only status word, and connection handles you can narrow to source-only or target-only so a start or terminal node offers no dead connection point. Ships a module-scope flowNodeTypes map, which makes React Flow's most-reported warning ("you have created a new nodeTypes object") impossible to trigger by accident.

items.name: focus-text
items.title: Focus Text
items.description: Depth-of-field text: every word sits slightly blurred except the focused one while a four-corner bracket springs between words on a per-instance layoutId, auto-cycling or controlled; the blur is design and stays under reduced motion — only the bracket travel collapses to an instant jump.

items.name: form
items.title: Form
items.description: react-hook-form + zod form primitives with accessible error wiring.

items.name: generated-image
items.title: Generated Image
items.description: Display for a model-generated image (data URI or URL) with a REQUIRED alt, a pulse placeholder until the bitmap decodes (cached-image safe), an optional caption, and a hover/focus download action; the pulse honors reduced motion.

items.name: github-stars-button
items.title: GitHub Stars Button
items.description: GitHub-style star-count link — outline surface, star icon and a props-fed count (never fetches) whose digits roll per changed column on update, end-keyed like motion-number; the rolling row is aria-hidden while the accessible name carries the real formatted count, and reduced motion swaps digits instantly.

items.name: glass-button
items.title: Glass Button
items.description: Frosted glassmorphism button — translucent blurred surface, soft border and a top inset highlight, made for imagery or gradient backdrops; keeping AA contrast of the backdrop behind it is the consumer’s responsibility.

items.name: glitch-text
items.title: Glitch Text
items.description: Digital glitch: the clean text stays put while two chromatic ghost copies (chart tokens by default) jump through clip-path slices and small offsets on a stepped keyframe loop, always-on or hover-only; the ghosts render via content: attr(data-text) on aria-hidden layers and are dropped entirely under reduced motion.

items.name: gradient-border-card
items.title: Gradient Border Card
items.description: Card ringed by a conic gradient whose highlight travels the full perimeter — an oversized aria-hidden conic layer spun by a transform-only keyframe inside an overflow-hidden box (no @property angle registration), parking as a static ring under reduced motion.

items.name: gradient-button
items.title: Gradient Button
items.description: Button on a flowing multi-stop gradient — a double-width background panning continuously via a background-position keyframe, colors and duration as props (chart tokens by default); under reduced motion the animation class is not applied and the same DOM shows the static gradient.

items.name: gradient-text
items.title: Gradient Text
items.description: Token-gradient text (primary → accent) with a slow animated shine that re-themes with the live palette; the shine runs only under motion-safe, leaving a fully-visible static gradient otherwise.

items.name: grid-pattern
items.title: Grid Pattern
items.description: Static SVG line-grid background with optional highlighted cells (squares as [column, row] pairs); lines default stroke-border and highlights fill-muted-foreground/20. Prerender-safe, nothing animates.

items.name: hero-01
items.title: Hero 01
items.description: Centered marketing hero — eyebrow badge, balanced headline, lead copy, primary + outline CTAs, and a muted wordmark strip over a dot-pattern backdrop. All copy, links, and the stack list are props; no trademarked logos ship.

items.name: highlight-text
items.title: Highlight Text
items.description: A marker highlight drawing across the text from the inline start once in view — a background-size transition on an inline gradient, dir-aware (the rtl variant flips the anchor edge) and cloned across line breaks; the text is never split, and reduced motion renders fully highlighted at rest.

items.name: hover-card
items.title: Hover Card
items.description: Preview card shown on hover for sighted users.

items.name: hover-reveal-text
items.title: Hover Reveal Text
items.description: Stroked outline SVG text where a radial mask follows the cursor, revealing a chart-token gradient fill through the glyphs — a pointer-only decorative enhancement over a readable stroked base (touch/keyboard users see the outline; reduced motion changes nothing, no animation is involved).

items.name: icon-button
items.title: Icon Button
items.description: Icon toggle (like/bookmark/star) that tints and glows in a chart-token color while active and fires a one-shot aria-hidden radial particle burst on activation — aria-pressed announces (no live region), the burst is skipped under reduced motion, and a plain non-toggle icon button remains the ui button with size="icon".

items.name: image-comparison
items.title: Image Comparison
items.description: Before/after comparison slider over arbitrary content or images — a hand-rolled WAI-ARIA slider handle with arrow/Home/End/Page keys (RTL-flipped event-time), pointer-capture dragging from anywhere on the surface, and pure logical-property clipping; nothing animates, dependency-free.

items.name: image-crop
items.title: Image Crop
items.description: Dependency-free crop-rect editor — a controlled percent rect over an image or any surface with pointer move/resize, aspect-ratio locking, a keyboard Move button plus a canonical Resize corner announcing through one polite region, and a documented canvas export recipe.

items.name: image-zoom
items.title: Image Zoom
items.description: Click-to-zoom lightbox for an image or arbitrary content — a Radix Dialog owns the focus trap, Escape, scroll lock and focus return while a motion spring scales the view over a blurred token backdrop; reduced motion swaps instantly with identical markup, closed at prerender.

items.name: inline-citation
items.title: Inline Citation
items.description: Superscript citation chip for AI answers: a real [n] button in the flowing text opening a hover-card of source cards, swipeable via carousel when a claim has several sources (mounted lazily by Radix) — keyboard users open it by focusing the chip.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: Themed single-line text input.

items.name: input-button
items.title: Input Button
items.description: Button that morphs into an inline input + submit on click (the compact newsletter-signup pattern) — closed by default for deterministic prerender, input focused from an effect (never autoFocus), Escape collapses and returns focus to the trigger, Enter or the submit button fires onSubmit; two controllable pairs (open, value), focus-within ring on the stable outer container, morph at duration 0 under reduced motion.

items.name: input-group
items.title: Input Group
items.description: Input with attached addons, buttons, and inline affixes.

items.name: input-otp
items.title: Input OTP
items.description: Accessible one-time-password segmented input.

items.name: interactive-hover-button
items.title: Interactive Hover Button
items.description: Button whose label slides out while an arrow-labelled primary fill expands in on hover — slide direction and arrow mirror under RTL.

items.name: iphone
items.title: Iphone
items.description: Generic modern-phone frame with a Dynamic-Island-style cutout and logical start/end side buttons — aria-hidden CSS art around an arbitrary screen slot on a labeled figure root; width-sized at 9:19.5, dependency-free, static, no Apple marks or model claims.

items.name: item
items.title: Item
items.description: Generic media/content row — icon, title, description, actions.

items.name: json-text
items.title: JSON Text
items.description: Syntax-toned collapsible JSON viewer over already-parsed data (never a string — no parse errors at render). Objects and arrays disclose behind real aria-expanded buttons whose collapsed preview ("{…} 3 entries") is real text; primitives tone by type through the palette. Hand-rolled disclosure — no portal machinery per node. Mono, LTR-pinned.

items.name: kbd
items.title: Kbd
items.description: Keyboard-key chip for shortcuts and key combos.

items.name: label
items.title: Label
items.description: Accessible form label paired to controls.

items.name: lcd-text
items.title: LCD Text
items.description: Seven-segment LCD rendering: one SVG per character from a static segment table, 1em tall and coloured by currentColor so any text token restyles it, with the classic faint unlit-segment ghost. One role="img" accessible name over aria-hidden glyphs — screen readers hear the value once, never segment soup. Static; glyph set 0-9 A-F - . : and space.

items.name: line-chart
items.title: Line Chart
items.description: Prop-driven line chart with monotone / linear / step curves, optional dots, per-point value labels, reference lines, axis tick formatters, and legend position; colours from var(--chart-1..5). Gaps stay gaps (connectNulls is not set). Entrance animation off, accessibilityLayer on, and an sr-only ChartDataTable alongside.

items.name: line-shadow-text
items.title: Line Shadow Text
items.description: Text with a diagonally-striped ghost shadow offset behind it, the stripes panning slowly on a keyframe loop for depth; the shadow renders via content: attr(data-text) on an aria-hidden glyph-clipped layer, and reduced motion holds the static stripes.

items.name: link-preview
items.title: Link Preview
items.description: Hover-card preview for a link fed entirely by props (no fetching) — a real anchor trigger that opens the thumbnail/title/description/domain card on hover or keyboard focus, never blocks navigation on touch, closed at prerender, motion-reduce-safe entrance.

items.name: liquid-button
items.title: Liquid Button
items.description: Button that fills with liquid on hover/focus-visible — the primary surface is the liquid and a background-colored spinning blob carves an undulating waterline over a resting puddle, sliding away so the fill rises; under reduced motion the blob parks and the rise is instant with identical DOM.

items.name: loading-button
items.title: Loading Button
items.description: Button with a controlled pending state — spinner + optional loadingText, aria-busy, and an aria-disabled click guard instead of the native disabled attribute so focus never drops to body; the Spinner’s role="status" announces (no extra live region), and reduced motion swaps content instantly.

items.name: log-stream-text
items.title: Log Stream Text
items.description: Log-line list with level tones: a fixed-width uppercase level chip (real text — never colour alone) beside a muted tabular timestamp and the message. Static by design; live mode swaps to role="log" so appended lines announce politely. Focusable labelled scroll region, LTR-pinned rows.

items.name: login-01
items.title: Login 01
items.description: Email + password login card over Card, Field, Input, and Button — required fields marked semantically and visually, optional OAuth button, forgot-password and sign-up links as props. Wire your auth call via onSubmit.

items.name: long-press-button
items.title: Long Press Button
items.description: Hold-to-confirm button for destructive actions — a start-anchored fill sweeps over holdDuration and onConfirm fires only when the full hold elapses, with early release rewinding; the SAME timed hold runs from the keyboard (Enter/Space keydown with auto-repeat guarded, keyup cancels), an sr-only description explains the gesture, one polite region announces the confirmation, and under reduced motion the fill snaps to a held tint with timing unchanged.

items.name: magic-card
items.title: Magic Card
items.description: Card whose border glow and interior spotlight follow the pointer through MotionValues (no per-move React render); idle or on touch the gradients park off-canvas leaving a plain border, and under reduced motion both layers park centered as a static highlight.

items.name: magnetic-button
items.title: Magnetic Button
items.description: Button gently attracted toward the pointer via motion springs, fine-pointer only, springing back on leave and fully static under reduced motion or coarse pointers.

items.name: marker
items.title: Marker
items.description: Status rows between messages — streaming state, tool activity, system notes, and labeled date separators (default, separator-rail, and bordered variants), with logical-direction rails that mirror under RTL.

items.name: marquee
items.title: Marquee
items.description: Infinite horizontal ticker for logo/brand strips — a duplicated aria-hidden track loops seamlessly via a -50% translate, pauses on hover, and renders as a static wrapped row under reduced motion.

items.name: mask-reveal-text
items.title: Mask Reveal Text
items.description: Two-phase curtain reveal: a token-colored panel sweeps across the text box, swapping the content in at the midpoint before sliding off — in-view triggered, prerender ships the visible text, and reduced motion drops the panel entirely.

items.name: masonry
items.title: Masonry
items.description: Dependency-free masonry over CSS multi-columns: zero measurement, no layout shift, prerender-correct first paint. Fixed count via the columns prop or responsive counts via Tailwind column utilities; each child wraps in a break-inside-avoid block. The documented trade: items flow column-major, with DOM, reading, and focus order agreeing.

items.name: menubar
items.title: Menubar
items.description: Desktop-style persistent menu bar.

items.name: message
items.title: Message
items.description: Chat message row — avatar anchored to the surface, start/end alignment (flex-order-based, so it mirrors under RTL), header and footer slots, and MessageGroup for consecutive same-sender stacks. Pure layout; compose Bubble for the visible surface.

items.name: message-scroller
items.title: Message Scroller
items.description: The conversation scroll container — a styled shell over the @shadcn/react headless primitives: bottom-anchored autoscroll for streaming replies, scroll-away detection, and a scroll-to-end button whose motion collapses under reduced motion. Self-contained: the shell mounts the engine provider itself (options are props — nothing to wrap). Bounded by its parent — give it a height.

items.name: meteors
items.title: Meteors
items.description: A field of chart-token meteor streaks raining diagonally across the container, with deterministic index-derived positions and timings (SSR-stable); under reduced motion the streaks park fully visible at their start positions.

items.name: metrics-01
items.title: Metrics 01
items.description: Analytics insights section — a dl summary row (Metric/MetricLabel/MetricValue) over our line-chart preset, which brings chart-token series colors and the sr-only data table. Summary and series are deterministic prop defaults; the heading carries the date range.

items.name: middle-truncation
items.title: Middle Truncation
items.description: Middle-ellipsis truncation that adapts to the container: the tail (extensions, hash suffixes) is always preserved while a hidden same-font measurer binary-searches the longest fitting head on every resize. Server and first client render show the FULL text — no hydration mismatch — and the sr-only full string plus title always carry the whole value. LTR-pinned content.

items.name: mini-calendar
items.title: Mini Calendar
items.description: Compact horizontal date strip — native-radio day cells with full-date accessible names and a today marker, prev/next paging announced through one polite region, min/max clamping, deterministic via a required today anchor; date-fns is its only engine.

items.name: minimal-card
items.title: Minimal Card
items.description: Soft borderless product tile — a wide-radius surface with a hairline inset ring and inner top highlight instead of a border, plus a triple-token-framed media slot that takes an image or arbitrary children at any aspect ratio.

items.name: model-selector
items.title: Model Selector
items.description: Searchable LLM picker: an outline combobox trigger opening a command palette grouped by provider, each provider keyed to a generic chart-token dot (no brand logos — theme-honest and trademark-free); filtering, keyboard navigation, and listbox semantics come from the command primitive.

items.name: morphing-text
items.title: Morphing Text
items.description: Per-character glyph morph while cycling strings: only characters that actually change cross-fade and scale in their slot, stable ones hold still; reduced motion swaps instantly over identical DOM, and the current string stays the accessible name over aria-hidden slots.

items.name: motion-dialog
items.title: Motion Dialog
items.description: Radix-based dialog with a spring-mounted panel and fading overlay — forceMount + AnimatePresence give Motion the exit while Radix keeps the focus trap, Escape, and aria wiring; reduced motion mounts and unmounts instantly.

items.name: motion-number
items.title: Motion Number
items.description: Numeric readout whose digits roll vertically on change — only the columns that actually changed animate, while the real value is announced once from an sr-only polite live region.

items.name: multi-select
items.title: Multi Select
items.description: Combobox-style popover trigger showing selected badges over a searchable Command list whose items toggle membership with check indicators.

items.name: native-select
items.title: Native Select
items.description: Styled native <select> with size variants and a chevron affordance — zero JS dropdown, ideal for OS-native pickers on mobile.

items.name: navigation-menu
items.title: Navigation Menu
items.description: Link collection with viewport-aware submenus.

items.name: neon-button
items.title: Neon Button
items.description: Outline button styled as a neon tube — colored border and label with layered color-mix glows that intensify on hover/focus-visible, plus an optional two-dip flicker (far below flash thresholds) that never runs under reduced motion, where the steady glow remains.

items.name: neon-gradient-card
items.title: Neon Gradient Card
items.description: Card wrapped in an animated chart-token neon gradient ring plus a blurred glow halo — pure CSS negative-inset layers with no measurement or effects, parked as a fully-visible static gradient ring under reduced motion.

items.name: neon-text
items.title: Neon Text
items.description: Neon-sign text glowing through layered color-mix text-shadow halos on a theme token, with an optional ambient buzz reusing the neon-flicker keyframes (two mild dips per cycle, far below flash thresholds); reduced motion keeps the steady glow.

items.name: number-ticker
items.title: Number Ticker
items.description: Animates a number to its value with a motion spring once in view (Intl-formatted, tabular-nums); shows the final value under reduced motion.

items.name: orbiting-circles
items.title: Orbiting Circles
items.description: Elements orbiting the center of their relative ancestor on a circular path, evenly spaced and counter-rotated upright, with a decorative aria-hidden SVG guide path; the 0% transform is mirrored inline so reduced motion parks the orbiters visible at their start angles — a static ring.

items.name: outline-text
items.title: Outline Text
items.description: Hollow stroked text whose solid fill sweeps in from the center on hover or in view — a background-clip gradient growing via background-size, symmetric and RTL-neutral; the glyphs stay real text throughout and reduced motion fills instantly.

items.name: package-info
items.title: Package Info
items.description: Npm-package display card: mono name, version with an optional previous → current transition (arrow flips under RTL, sr-only "updated from X to Y"), a definition-list meta block with a compact en-US downloads formatter, and a dependency chip list. Props-fed — nothing is fetched.

items.name: pagination
items.title: Pagination
items.description: Page navigation with previous/next and page links.

items.name: parallax
items.title: Parallax
items.description: Subtle scroll-linked vertical parallax wrapper — a raw linear map of scroll progress to translateY (GPU transform only); the prerender ships the untransformed static frame via an rAF arm-gate, and OS reduced motion or the shared reduce-motion toggle collapses it to static.

items.name: password-input
items.title: Password Input
items.description: Password field with an inside-end visibility toggle and an optional 4-segment strength meter (text level, polite live region — never color-only).

items.name: path-draw
items.title: Path Draw
items.description: SVG stroke that draws itself by scrubbing pathLength from 0 to 1 as it scrolls into view — geometry, viewBox, stroke, and timing are props; the prerender ships the path fully drawn (rAF arm-gate) and reduced motion keeps it static.

items.name: phone-input
items.title: Phone Input
items.description: Dial-code select plus type="tel" input reporting a combined { dial, number } value; dependency-free — validate the composed value consumer-side with zod.

items.name: pie-chart
items.title: Pie Chart
items.description: Prop-driven pie or donut for parts of a whole, with an optional centre total, slice labels outside (leader lines) or inside the slices showing names or values, adjustable slice separators (strokeWidth 0 removes them), and legend position. Slice colours come from the var(--chart-1..5) ramp via Cell (slice names are free text, so custom-property names are avoided). Entrance animation off; recharts has no accessibilityLayer for pies, so the sr-only ChartDataTable is the only route to the numbers.

items.name: pill-button
items.title: Pill Button
items.description: Fully rounded tinted pill — a primary-tinted surface with a subtle ring and a light-top/dark-bottom double inset shadow that reads as a curved surface on any palette; pure CSS, no animation.

items.name: pin-list
items.title: Pin List
items.description: Pin-to-top favorites list — controllable pinnedIds over two heading-labelled sections, aria-pressed pin toggles with accessible names, motion layout morphs between sections with focus restored to the moved toggle, one polite move announcement, instant reflow under reduced motion.

items.name: plan
items.title: Plan
items.description: Collapsible task-planning card for agent UIs: done steps strike through, the active step shimmers while the plan streams, todo steps wait muted — each with an sr-only status suffix; props-fed, aria-expanded from Radix, shimmer collapsing under reduced motion.

items.name: pop-text
items.title: Pop Text
items.description: Cartoon impact reveal: each glyph pops in with overshoot scale and a deterministic tilt that settles upright, plus an optional starburst flash behind the text; prerender ships the plain visible text (rAF arm-gate) and reduced motion stays static with the decorative burst dropped.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: Floating content panel anchored to a trigger.

items.name: progress
items.title: Progress
items.description: Bar communicating completion of a task.

items.name: prompt-input
items.title: Prompt Input
items.description: Chat composer for AI interfaces: auto-growing textarea (Enter sends, Shift+Enter breaks the line, IME composition respected) over toolbar action slots, an attachments row whose remove buttons return focus to the textarea, and a send button kept focusable while disabled (aria-disabled + submit guard). Props-fed — no AI SDK, no fetching, no speech capture.

items.name: pulsating-button
items.title: Pulsating Button
items.description: Call-to-action button with a soft, continuously pulsing halo in a chart-token color; the halo is not rendered under reduced motion.

items.name: queue
items.title: Queue
items.description: Collapsible queue of pending agent work: an inbox trigger with a total badge over titled sections whose items tick off as they complete, with a built-in empty state — props-fed, aria-expanded from Radix collapsible.

items.name: radar-chart
items.title: Radar Chart
items.description: Prop-driven radar for comparing measures across shared axes — polygon or circular grid, tinted grid fill, radial spoke lines on or off, explicit ring radii, axis tick formatting, legend position; colours from var(--chart-1..5). Entrance animation off; recharts has no accessibilityLayer for radars, so the sr-only ChartDataTable carries the data. Area grows with the square of the radius — good for shape, not for exact values.

items.name: radial-chart
items.title: Radial Chart
items.description: Prop-driven radial bar chart — concentric arcs per row, or a gauge with a shortened sweep; legend position top or bottom. Pass max to pin the scale so arc lengths stay comparable. Colours from the var(--chart-1..5) ramp via Cell; entrance animation off; the sr-only ChartDataTable carries the data (no accessibilityLayer for radials).

items.name: radio-group
items.title: Radio Group
items.description: Set of mutually exclusive options.

items.name: range-slider-with-ticks
items.title: Range Slider With Ticks
items.description: Dual-thumb range slider with aria-hidden tick marks, individually labeled thumbs, and a visible current-range readout wired as the group description.

items.name: rating
items.title: Rating
items.description: Star rating as a radio group of native sr-only inputs — arrow-key roving and per-step announcements for free, pointer hover preview, optional half steps and click-to-clear, and a readOnly role="img" summary mode with RTL-correct partial fills.

items.name: reasoning
items.title: Reasoning
items.description: Collapsible AI thinking display: the trigger shimmers while the model streams (auto-opens, auto-closes when done) and shows a "Thought for Ns" chip afterwards — props-fed, no AI SDK; Radix collapsible supplies aria-expanded and the shimmer collapses to plain text under reduced motion.

items.name: record-button
items.title: Record Button
items.description: Round record toggle whose inner dot morphs circle↔stop-square on a spring, with a looping aria-hidden pulse ring while recording — state announced natively via aria-pressed (deliberately no live region); controlled or uncontrolled, and under reduced motion the pulse is not rendered and the morph is instant with identical interactive DOM.

items.name: reduce-motion-toggle
items.title: Reduce Motion Toggle
items.description: Labeled switch row plus the useReduceMotionToggle hook it exports — a session-only reduce-motion preference in a module-scope store (useSyncExternalStore, no cookies/localStorage) that motion components fold in beside the OS setting.

items.name: regex-text
items.title: Regex Text
items.description: Regex match highlighter: every match wraps in a semantic mark toned through the palette; an invalid pattern renders the text plain with an sr-only note instead of throwing. Optional pattern chip (LTR mono) and sr-only match count. The sample text keeps the page direction — prose may be RTL.

items.name: relative-time
items.title: Relative Time
items.description: Live timestamp on a semantic <time> element — Intl.RelativeTimeFormat "3 minutes ago" text or an Intl world clock via timeZone, deterministic SSR through a reference-now prop, adaptive post-hydration ticking, absolute title fallback, announcements off by default; dependency-free.

items.name: resizable
items.title: Resizable
items.description: Accessible resizable panel groups and handles.

items.name: retro-grid
items.title: Retro Grid
items.description: Animated perspective grid scrolling toward the viewer, with a theme-reactive lineColor and a fade over the horizon (not the near field, which is where the readable floor is); the loop slides the background texture exactly one grid cell — the tilted plane itself never moves, so the repeat is seamless and the rows nearest the viewer render solid — and parks as a fully-visible static plane under reduced motion.

items.name: reveal
items.title: Reveal
items.description: One-shot fade + slide-up as the element scrolls into view (plays once); the prerender ships fully-visible HTML (client-side arm-gate) and reduced motion collapses to a plain container.

items.name: reveal-text
items.title: Reveal Text
items.description: Masked line reveal for headlines (the live-up pattern) — each line slides up from behind an overflow clip, staggered; the prerender ships the real visible text (rAF arm-gate) and reduced motion keeps it static.

items.name: ripple
items.title: Ripple
items.description: Concentric foreground-token circles pulsing outward from the center with a staggered delay; the pulse is a CSS animation that parks the rings fully visible at scale 1 under reduced motion.

items.name: ripple-button
items.title: Ripple Button
items.description: Button that emits a soft low-opacity ripple from the exact click point; no ripple is created under reduced motion.

items.name: rolling-text
items.title: Rolling Text
items.description: The hover roll: each glyph lives in a one-line clipped cell with two stacked copies, and hovering slides every cell up one line with a per-character delay to roll the accent copy in — pure CSS translate transitions, instant under reduced motion; raw string as accessible name over aria-hidden cells.

items.name: safari
items.title: Safari
items.description: Generic macOS-style browser mockup — monochrome traffic dots, nav affordances and a display-only URL pill as one aria-hidden decorative layer around an open screen slot, on a labeled figure root; pure CSS, dependency-free, static, no brand marks.

items.name: schema-display
items.title: Schema Display
items.description: API-endpoint documentation display: method badge + LTR mono path over labelled field sections, each a real table with scoped column headers. The method text is the channel (badge variant is decoration); required fields carry a visible asterisk plus sr-only "(required)". Props-fed structural docs — no OpenAPI parser.

items.name: scramble-text
items.title: Scramble Text
items.description: Characters near the cursor scramble and settle back as it moves away — glyphs mutated imperatively in a rAF loop started on first pointerenter (zero idle cost), a purely decorative pointer enhancement over readable static text that stays inert without a pointer or under reduced motion.

items.name: scroll-area
items.title: Scroll Area
items.description: Custom-styled cross-browser scroll container.

items.name: scroll-progress
items.title: Scroll Progress
items.description: Fixed top-of-page scroll progress bar driven by useScroll + scaleX with a chart-token gradient; scroll-linked, so it still renders under reduced motion.

items.name: search-highlight-text
items.title: Search Highlight Text
items.description: Query-match highlighter over a plain substring scan — no regex, so user input never needs escaping. Matches wrap in semantic mark elements toned through the palette; no live region (the search box driving the query owns announcing). Case-insensitive by default; keeps the page direction.

items.name: search-input
items.title: Search Input
items.description: Search field with a start-side icon, clear-and-refocus button, Escape-to-clear, Enter submit, and a politely announced loading spinner.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: Listbox-style picker with keyboard support.

items.name: separator
items.title: Separator
items.description: Visual divider between content areas.

items.name: shake-button
items.title: Shake Button
items.description: Button that shakes horizontally to signal a rejected action — motion x-keyframes paired with a destructive ring flash (color channel, so motion is never the only signal) and one polite announcement of the message; controlled via shake/onShakeEnd or local shakeOnClick, and under reduced motion the ring and announcement still fire without the x-burst.

items.name: sheet
items.title: Sheet
items.description: Slide-in panel from any screen edge.

items.name: shimmer-button
items.title: Shimmer Button
items.description: Primary-surface button with a shine that travels around its border ring; the spark layer is skipped under reduced motion.

items.name: shine-border
items.title: Shine Border
items.description: An animated background-position shine sweeping around a container's border ring, parked as a static gradient ring under reduced motion.

items.name: shine-button
items.title: Shine Button
items.description: Primary button swept by a single diagonal shine stripe on hover and focus-visible — one aria-hidden gradient layer on a CSS transform transition (not shimmer-button’s border spark, not shine-border’s container ring); instant, effectively static, under reduced motion.

items.name: sidebar
items.title: Sidebar
items.description: Composable app sidebar with mobile off-canvas mode.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: Loading placeholder block.

items.name: skeleton-text
items.title: Skeleton Text
items.description: Word-shaped skeleton bars that cross-fade into the real copy: while loading each word is its own pulse bar (the word rendered transparent, so widths are exact and the swap shifts no layout) behind aria-busy + one sr-only Loading label; reduced motion stops the pulse and swaps instantly.

items.name: slide-to-unlock
items.title: Slide To Unlock
items.description: Drag-to-confirm control whose thumb is a real button — drag past ~90% of the track or press Enter to confirm, with a polite announcement once confirmed.

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: Range input for selecting a value.

items.name: snippet
items.title: Snippet
items.description: One-line copyable CLI command: an aria-hidden prompt symbol, the command kept LTR in mono, and a copy button whose icon morphs to a check for two seconds with a polite sr-only Copied announcement.

items.name: social-links-01
items.title: Social Links 01
items.description: Profile-links grid — lucide platform icons in token discs (no brand image assets), stretched-link hover rows with exactly one focusable link each, and an RTL-mirrored external-arrow affordance. Links arrive via props.

items.name: social-proof-01
items.title: Social Proof 01
items.description: Logo-strip social proof over our marquee — fictional text wordmarks instead of trademarked brand SVGs, an uppercase muted heading, and the marquee's static wrapped fallback under reduced motion.

items.name: sonner
items.title: Sonner (Toasts)
items.description: Toast notifications coloured by the theme tokens — follows light/dark with no theme provider. The registry's toast solution: upstream's Radix-base toast is deprecated in favor of sonner.

items.name: sortable
items.title: Sortable
items.description: Headless drag-and-drop base over @dnd-kit — a provider preset (pointer + keyboard sensors, auto-scroll, drag feedback, no engine live region) plus sortable-item / draggable / drop-zone hooks and the house announcement wording. Keyboard matches the grab contract (Space lifts, arrows move spatially, Escape cancels); commit order in onDragOver with a snapshot restored on cancel; transitions and the drop animation collapse under reduced motion. The engine behind the data-grid drag surfaces — sortable-list remains the styled motion list.

items.name: sortable-list
items.title: Sortable List
items.description: Drag-to-reorder vertical list on motion's Reorder primitives — handle-only pointer drag with FLIP springs plus a full Space-lift/arrow-move/Space-drop/Escape-cancel keyboard grab pattern, one polite live region announcing every move, instant reflow under reduced motion; controlled items/onReorder.

items.name: sources
items.title: Sources
items.description: Collapsible citation list for RAG answers: a "Used N sources" trigger over real external links with titles and optional descriptions (rel=noreferrer) — props-fed, aria-expanded from Radix collapsible.

items.name: sparkles-text
items.title: Sparkles Text
items.description: Text surrounded by twinkling chart-token sparkle stars, generated client-side only; plain text under reduced motion.

items.name: spinner
items.title: Spinner
items.description: Inline loading indicator.

items.name: split-text
items.title: Split Text
items.description: The foundational split-and-stagger engine: text broken into characters, words, or lines, each fragment sliding or blurring in once scrolled into view — prerender ships the plain visible text (rAF arm-gate), the raw string stays the accessible name over aria-hidden glyphs, and reduced motion keeps it static.

items.name: spotlight-card
items.title: Spotlight Card
items.description: Card grid where one pointer lights whichever cards it crosses — a single rAF-throttled handler writes card-relative CSS custom properties (zero React renders per move) so the glow spans card boundaries; reduced motion parks the wash centered and permanently visible.

items.name: spotlight-text
items.title: Spotlight Text
items.description: Dim text lit by a soft circular beam following the pointer — a CSS mask over an aria-hidden bright copy positioned imperatively (zero re-renders per move); the dim base stays AA-readable on its own, and reduced motion renders fully lit with no beam layer.

items.name: stack-trace
items.title: Stack Trace
items.description: Parsed stack-trace display: error name + message over an ordered frame list. Frame locations become real buttons only when an onFrameSelect handler is given; frames marked internal render muted and fold behind an aria-expanded "N internal frames" disclosure. Every file:line:column pins LTR. Props-fed — pass pre-parsed frames.

items.name: stagger
items.title: Stagger
items.description: Stagger + StaggerItem pair that cascades children into view with a fade-up as the group enters the viewport; the prerender ships fully-visible HTML (client-side arm-gate) and reduced motion renders the static twin.

items.name: stat-counters
items.title: Stat Counters
items.description: Row of stat cards whose numbers count up as they scroll into view — each card is a dl pair (label read with its value, final number always in the prerendered text) with per-stat prefix, suffix, and icon.

items.name: status
items.title: Status
items.description: System-health badge — token-colored dot with an animate-ping echo silenced by motion-reduce at the CSS layer, an always-visible label so color is never the only channel, and a role="status" root that politely announces runtime flips; dependency-free.

items.name: step-switcher
items.title: Step Switcher
items.description: Direction-aware multi-step switcher on AnimatePresence mode="wait" — the outgoing step exits toward the travel direction before the incoming one enters from the opposite side; step one prerenders fully visible and the counter is a polite live region.

items.name: stitch-button
items.title: Stitch Button
items.description: Solid button with an aria-hidden dashed stitch seam inset inside its edge and gentle fabric-like inner shading; pure CSS, no animation.

items.name: success-button
items.title: Success Button
items.description: Button that flips to a check + success label after a click and reverts after resetDelay — controlled or uncontrolled status via use-controllable-state, one polite live region announcing the success (the visual swap alone is silent), instant swap under reduced motion; see copy-button for the clipboard-specific take.

items.name: suggestion
items.title: Suggestion
items.description: Horizontally scrolling quick-reply pills for chat: native buttons in DOM order inside a scroll area (keyboard reaches every pill) with aria-hidden dir-aware edge fades hinting the overflow — props-fed.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: Binary toggle control.

items.name: syntax-text
items.title: Syntax Text
items.description: Token-highlighted code — the shiki seam, not shiki: a one-pass approximate tokenizer (comments, strings, numbers, an overridable keyword set, punctuation) or pre-tokenized lines for a faithful grammar. Every colour is a palette token, and tokens are plain text in document order so assistive tech reads one coherent string. Inline or block; pairs into code-block via its pre-tokenized children seam. LTR-pinned.

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: Styled table primitives (header, body, caption, footer).

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Layered sections shown one at a time.

items.name: tags-input
items.title: Tags Input
items.description: Chips-and-inline-input field: Enter or comma commits a tag, Backspace on empty removes the last, duplicates ignored, add/remove announced in a polite live region.

items.name: task
items.title: Task
items.description: Collapsible search-style progress display for a running AI operation: a caption trigger ("Read 12 files") over rows of touched items with optional mono file chips — props-fed, aria-expanded from Radix collapsible.

items.name: team-01
items.title: Team 01
items.description: Team member grid over Card — chart-token initials discs (no remote avatars), name + handle per member, two to four columns. Members arrive via props.

items.name: terminal
items.title: Terminal
items.description: macOS-style terminal window for CLI demos — aria-hidden chrome with a visible title, a focusable labeled horizontal scroll region, line/output subcomponents whose prompt glyphs stay silent to screen readers, and an optional CSS caret blink that motion-reduce stops; the typed-out animation is a separate future variant.

items.name: terminal-log
items.title: Terminal Log
items.description: ANSI-toned log display — the content half of a terminal (the devices terminal item stays the window chrome; they compose). A clean-room SGR-subset parser maps colours onto the palette tokens and strips everything else, so assistive tech reads clean text. Focusable labelled scroll region; live mode swaps to role="log" so appended lines announce politely. Content pins LTR.

items.name: test-results
items.title: Test Results
items.description: Test-suite results for agent output: a summary row of count badges over per-test rows with status icons and durations — distinct icon shapes plus sr-only status text keep color from ever being the only channel.

items.name: testimonial-card
items.title: Testimonial Card
items.description: Semantic testimonial surface — a figure holding a blockquote plus a figcaption author row with a ring-framed avatar (token initials disc when no portrait), name, optional verified badge paired with an sr-only word, and tagline.

items.title: Testimonials 01

items.title: Tooltip

items.name: typography

items.name: underline-button
