items.name: use-boolean
items.title: useBoolean
items.description: Boolean state with named stable actions — value, setValue, setTrue, setFalse, toggle — safe to pass into dependency arrays and memoized children; the tuple flavor is use-toggle.

items.name: use-click-anywhere
items.title: useClickAnywhere
items.description: Run a handler on any document pointerdown while enabled — dismissal layers, tap-to-continue screens, coach marks; latest-handler ref, listener attached only while enabled. Outside-a-subtree dismissal is use-click-outside.

items.name: use-click-outside
items.title: useClickOutside
items.description: Pointerdown-outside-a-subtree dismissal for hand-rolled popups — document listener only while enabled, latest handler through a ref. Radix overlays ship their own; this is for custom surfaces.

items.name: use-controllable-state
items.title: useControllableState
items.description: One state that works controlled or uncontrolled — the value?/onChange?/defaultProp pattern reduced to a hook, with functional updates resolved against the rendered value and no-op writes dropped. A small take on the Radix concept.

items.name: use-copy-to-clipboard
items.title: useCopyToClipboard
items.description: Clipboard writes with a self-resetting copied flag for "Copied!" affordances — resolves false when the Clipboard API is unavailable so callers can fall back. The hook behind the copy-button item pattern.

items.name: use-countdown
items.title: useCountdown
items.description: Tick-based countdown from `from` to 0 — start (restarting from zero), pause, reset, and an isRunning flag, stopping automatically at zero; ticks are a setTimeout chain in an effect, so prerendered HTML always shows the starting count. The self-locking button on this pattern is countdown-button.

items.name: use-counter
items.title: useCounter
items.description: Numeric counter clamped to optional inclusive min/max bounds — increment, decrement, set (value or updater, result clamped) and reset, all with stable identities while the bounds hold.

items.name: use-debounce
items.title: useDebouncedValue / useDebouncedCallback
items.description: Debounce a value (settles after delayMs of quiet) or a callback (only the last call in a burst fires) — timers live in effects and clear on unmount, so both are prerender-safe.

items.name: use-document-title
items.title: useDocumentTitle
items.description: Set document.title while mounted — the previous title is captured before the first write and optionally restored on unmount (restoreOnUnmount); effect-only, so prerender never touches document, and a router that also writes titles simply wins last.

items.name: use-event-callback
items.title: useEventCallback
items.description: A stable function identity that always invokes the LATEST closure — the useEvent pattern for handlers in dependency arrays and subscriptions that must not re-subscribe per render; the ref is written in a pre-paint isomorphic layout effect, and it is not for calling during render.

items.name: use-event-listener
items.title: useEventListener
items.description: Typed addEventListener as a hook — window by default, or a Document / element-ref target via overloads; the latest handler rides a ref so inline closures never re-subscribe, and subscription plus default-target resolution live inside the effect, keeping prerender window-free.

items.name: use-fine-pointer
items.title: useFinePointer
items.description: True on hover-capable fine-pointer devices ((hover: hover) and (pointer: fine)) via useSyncExternalStore — prerender-safe (false server snapshot); gates hover-only effects so touch users get the static state, a capability query, never UA sniffing.

items.name: use-hover
items.title: useHover
items.description: Whether the element behind a ref is hovered — pointerenter/leave in an effect, false at prerender and on non-hovering devices; hover is an enhancement channel, so keep a focus or tap path for anything it reveals.

items.name: use-intersection-observer
items.title: useIntersectionObserver
items.description: Element visibility via IntersectionObserver — options destructured to primitive effect deps (threshold serialized) so inline option objects never re-create the observer, false at prerender, and freezeOnceVisible keeps the first visible entry as the reveal-on-scroll latch.

items.name: use-interval
items.title: useInterval
items.description: setInterval as a hook — fires the LATEST callback every delayMs (ref-forwarded, so inline closures never go stale or restart the timer), pauses on null, re-arms only when the delay changes; prerender-safe with the timer in an effect.

items.name: use-is-client
items.title: useIsClient
items.description: False during prerender AND the first hydration render, true afterwards — read via useSyncExternalStore snapshots instead of an effect + setState tick, for gating browser-only UI (portals, measurements, time-dependent text) without hydration mismatches.

items.name: use-is-mounted
items.title: useIsMounted
items.description: A stable () => boolean predicate reporting whether the component is still mounted — the guard for state writes after an await in handlers or subscriptions; prefer AbortController for cancellable fetches.

items.name: use-isomorphic-layout-effect
items.title: useIsomorphicLayoutEffect
items.description: useLayoutEffect wherever a DOM exists and useEffect during server/prerender rendering — kills React’s "useLayoutEffect does nothing on the server" warning for pre-paint measure-then-write work; the typeof document probe never dereferences, so module scope stays prerender-safe.

items.name: use-local-storage
items.title: useLocalStorage
items.description: JSON state persisted under a localStorage key and synced across components (local emitter) and tabs (storage event). Prerender shows the initial value; corrupt entries and quota errors fall back silently.

items.name: use-map
items.title: useMap
items.description: Map state with immutable updates — set, setAll, remove, clear and reset each clone into a NEW Map so React re-renders and memoized consumers see a changed reference; the map is exposed read-only and the actions object is stable.

items.name: use-media-query
items.title: useMediaQuery
items.description: Subscribe to any media query — viewport, capability, or preference (e.g. prefers-reduced-motion) — via useSyncExternalStore with a deterministic server snapshot. The generalized sibling of useIsMobile.

items.name: use-mobile
items.title: useIsMobile
items.description: Viewport-below-768px hook via useSyncExternalStore — prerender-safe (false on the server snapshot).

items.name: use-motion-armed
items.title: useMotionArmed
items.description: The SSG arm gate: false at prerender and on the first hydration render, then true before the next paint — so an entrance can mount client-side while the prerendered HTML ships the real, fully-visible content. Pass enabled:false to hold it closed.

items.name: use-mouse-position
items.title: useMousePosition
items.description: The pointer’s viewport coordinates, null until the first move — window pointermove in an effect, prerender-safe; re-renders per move, so per-frame visual work (spotlights, glows) should instead write CSS custom properties from one rAF-throttled handler, the spotlight-card technique.

items.name: use-resize-observer
items.title: useResizeObserver
items.description: The content-box width/height of the element behind a ref, tracked by one ResizeObserver in an effect — both undefined at prerender and until the observer’s initial callback right after observe().

items.name: use-screen
items.title: useScreen
items.description: The MONITOR’s size (window.screen), null at prerender — the same raw-string useSyncExternalStore pattern as use-window-size, additionally re-checked on orientationchange since rotation swaps the screen axes; use-window-size is the viewport equivalent.

items.name: use-script
items.title: useScript
items.description: Load an external script once and report idle → loading → ready | error — deduplicates via a script[src] query plus a data-status stamp so many consumers share one tag, creates the tag in an effect with status writes as microtasks, null src stays idle, and removeOnUnmount deletes only a tag this hook created.

items.name: use-scroll-lock
items.title: useScrollLock
items.description: Lock a scroll container (document.body by default, or a ref target) while a flag holds — overflow hidden with the vanished scrollbar compensated via paddingInlineEnd (logical, RTL-correct), both restored on cleanup; the target resolves at effect time so prerender stays DOM-free. Radix overlays ship their own lock.

items.name: use-session-storage
items.title: useSessionStorage
items.description: JSON state persisted under a sessionStorage key — use-local-storage’s exact shape (raw-string snapshot via useSyncExternalStore, memo parse, local emitter, swallowed quota errors) over the per-TAB store: survives reloads, isolated per tab, gone when the tab closes.

items.name: use-step
items.title: useStep
items.description: 1-based wizard step state — next/prev/goTo silently clamp to [1, totalSteps], reset returns to the initial step, and isFirst/isLast derive from the current position; the rendered control equivalent is the step-switcher item.

items.name: use-timeout
items.title: useTimeout
items.description: setTimeout as a hook — runs the latest callback once after delayMs, cancels on null, re-arms from now when the delay changes; the ref-forwarded callback never re-arms it, and the timer lives in an effect so prerender is safe.

items.name: use-toggle
items.title: useToggle
items.description: Boolean state as a [value, toggle] tuple — toggle() flips, toggle(next) forces a state, with a stable identity; the named-actions flavor is use-boolean.

items.name: use-unmount
items.title: useUnmount
items.description: Run a cleanup exactly at unmount — the latest fn is called (ref-forwarded) so it sees current props and state; StrictMode’s dev remount cycle runs it too, the same caveat as any effect cleanup.

items.name: use-window-size
items.title: useWindowSize
items.description: The viewport size, null at prerender and on the first hydration render — useSyncExternalStore over a primitive raw-string snapshot (object snapshots would loop the store) parsed in a memo; the monitor’s size is use-screen, a boolean breakpoint is use-media-query.

items.name: utils
items.title: utils (cn)
items.description: cn() class-name combiner — clsx + tailwind-merge.

items.name: vanish-input
items.title: Vanish Input
items.description: Text input with a cycling animated placeholder and a per-character vanish flourish that dissolves the submitted text on Enter.

items.name: wave-text
items.title: Wave Text
items.description: A continuous traveling sine: every glyph rides one translateY keyframe loop with a per-character negative phase offset so the crest travels along the string — pure CSS, zero per-frame JavaScript; raw string as accessible name over aria-hidden glyphs, flat baseline under reduced motion.

items.name: web-preview
items.title: Web Preview
items.description: Iframe preview shell for AI-built pages: back/forward/refresh navigation (focusable-when-inert via aria-disabled, arrows flipping under RTL) with a read-only LTR address field, a sandboxed iframe REQUIRING a title, and a collapsible console panel with level-toned log lines — navigation handlers stay the consumer’s.

items.name: wheel-picker
items.title: Wheel Picker
items.description: iOS-style drum picker: a five-row viewport with a center selection band, spring-snapped 3D rows, and full listbox keyboard, wheel, and drag support.

items.name: word-rotate
items.title: Word Rotate
items.description: Vertically rotates through a list of words with AnimatePresence; instant swaps under reduced motion with the full list exposed accessibly.
